analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 31, 2026, hosted by X-B4 Advisory and addressed by Founder and Promoter Ankur Gaba. Management reported strong financial and operational growth, driven by core business expansion, new branches, and progress in its digital platform AkikoPay. The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance upward to INR325 crores to INR350 crores while maintaining profitability and long-term hybrid growth strategies. Furthermore, management highlighted upcoming integrations for insurance and mutual funds as well as plans to strengthen upper management. Akiko Global Services Limited reported strong operational performance in Q1 FY27, with monthly loan disbursals exceeding ₹450 crore and credit card sourcing scaling to 17,000-18,000 cards monthly.

guidance.claim: Management revised its revenue guidance for FY27 to INR325 crores to INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins of 9% to 11% for the current year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a CAGR of 70% to 100% year-on-year for the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident in achieving its revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore for FY27.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: The company expects a minimum of 70% to 100% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company has a long-term vision to reach INR 1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q1 FY27 revenue to be between INR 65 crores and INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: This quarter I'll close around INR65 crores to INR70 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects AkikoPay to generate around INR 50 crores in revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: The company's overall revenue outlook for FY27 is above INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The sourcing pipeline is healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently growing the fastest among all loan products.
The company recorded strong revenue growth supported by momentum across its credit card sourcing and lending divisions.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company delivered robust revenue growth while maintaining healthy profitability, supported by sustained momentum across its credit card sourcing and lending businesses, reflecting the resilience of its diversified business model.

demand_outlook.claim: The Dubai business has started reviving from April onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: And, it has started reviving again from April onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees more potential in growing its unsecured business this year.
demand_outlook.quote: So we have decided that if we can grow business more from unsecured without any fund-raise, we have more potential, then this year we will go towards unsecured business rather than a secured business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has 25 branches across 19 cities in India, all of which are on rent or lease.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: New branches have recently been added in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad, with Indore and Kerala lined up.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones. Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is under development and scheduled to offer a comprehensive experience in the coming months.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its company-owned branch presence across multiple cities.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities.

capex_expansion.claim: AkikoPay is expected to go live on iOS within the month.
capex_expansion.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

capex_expansion.claim: Mutual funds and insurance are expected to go live by August.
capex_expansion.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in talks to exclusively partner with Upstox to sell demat accounts.
capex_expansion.quote: And even we are going to start with, we are in talks with Upstox also that we are also planning to sell their demat account, so that will be the exclusive partnership.

margins_costs.claim: In the unsecured loan segment, the average payout is 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Employees on the loan and card sides receive fixed salaries plus incentives.
margins_costs.quote: So they get a fixed salary plus incentives, so they are happy.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a disciplined approach toward scalable and profitable growth while continuing to invest in technology and digital capabilities.
margins_costs.quote: The Company continues to invest in technology, digital capabilities and customer experience while maintaining a disciplined approach towards scalable and profitable growth.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 margin pressure was driven by planned investments in branch expansion, technology, and AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical issues in the Iran region caused temporary margin pressure in Dubai operations.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

margins_costs.claim: The company is building AkikoPay with negligible customer acquisition costs.
margins_costs.quote: We are not burning any single penny on AkikoPay because we have made a huge empire, we have 1,500 employees, we have a database of 25 million, so we are going to monetize that.

margins_costs.claim: The company's customer acquisition cost is around INR 10 to INR 15.
margins_costs.quote: Where Paytm, PhonePe or CRED spends around INR250 to acquire a customer, there our cost comes to INR10 to INR15.

orders_capacity.claim: The company dispatches 18,000 credit cards and INR450 crores in monthly loan disbursements.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we disburse almost 18,000 cards, plus INR450 crores is your monthly loan disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: AkikoPay receives 200 to 300 credit leads daily on average.
orders_capacity.quote: On AkikoPay, credit leads coming in such as for loans and credit cards, if I look at the daily average, we are getting 200 to 300 leads.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals reached over ₹450 crore while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has reached a monthly loan disbursement run rate of over INR 400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total combined workforce has crossed 900.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's unsecured loan book stands at INR 320 crores, while the secured book is INR 80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Unsecured book is INR320 crores, rest is secured book.

capital_allocation.claim: There are absolutely no plans for fundraising right now as internal accruals and bank support are sufficient.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is focusing on building a sustainable payment and credit ecosystem without a cash-burn model.
capital_allocation.quote: And one thing I would like to clearly say here, we are not building any cash-burn fintech model.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai business revenue faced pressure in the first quarter due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situations around the Iran region caused temporary margin pressure in Dubai.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

risks_headwinds.claim: Secured loans like housing loans increase receivable days and pressure operating cash flows.
risks_headwinds.quote: And the problem in that is that our receivable days increase because if anyone takes a housing loan, takes a mortgage, then the disbursement time becomes two to three months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Compliance issues delayed the launch of AkikoPay on the App Store.
risks_headwinds.quote: We haven't even started the expansion yet because it is still pending on the App Store, due to some compliance.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Apple App Store version 2 of AkikoPay will be enabled within 4 to 5 days.
management_commitments.quote: On the App Store, you will see its new version within 3 days to 4 days.

management_commitments.claim: Integration of insurance and mutual funds into AkikoPay will begin and show visibility in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: That will take 2 months. So, in the next quarter, you will see business visibility for insurance and mutual funds within it.

management_commitments.claim: Receivable days are expected to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Employee count is targeted to reach 1,400 to 1,500 by the end of the quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: There is a plan for a total of 25 branches this year.
management_commitments.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to deliver revenue between ₹300 and ₹325 crore with healthy profitability in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS application of AkikoPay is expected to offer a comprehensive financial services experience in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to grow its unsecured loan book to INR 1,000 crores by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching 1 million customer downloads for AkikoPay by December 31.
management_commitments.quote: Yes. In this I have planned that in quarter one or two, we will be live everywhere, so I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects mutual funds and insurance to go live by August.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

management_commitments.claim: Ankur Gaba plans to take the Managing Director position in the next one or two months.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, 100%. Most likely in the next one or two months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
